description: A utility helper class for interacting with the OpenTracing API, providing methods for logging errors, injecting and extracting span contexts into various transport mediums such as JSON objects, AMQP messages, and Vert.x headers, as well as methods for building and managing tracing spans.

classes.name: TracingHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for OpenTracing span management, context propagation, error logging, and span building.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Marks a span as erroneous and logs an exception or error message; does not finish the span.

methods.name: getErrorLogItems
methods.description: Creates a map of log items for an error, including the error object.

methods.name: injectSpanContext
methods.description: Injects a SpanContext into a JSON object, AMQP message annotations, or Vert.x headers, depending on overload.

methods.name: extractSpanContext
methods.description: Extracts a SpanContext from a JSON object, AMQP message, or Vert.x headers, depending on overload.

methods.name: buildChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new span builder that is a child of the given span context with a child-of reference.

methods.name: buildFollowsFromSpan
methods.description: Creates a new span builder that has a follows-from reference to the given span context.

methods.name: buildSpan
methods.description: Creates a span builder with a specified reference type to the given span context.

methods.name: setTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Sets the sampling priority as a tag and baggage item in a span.

methods.name: adoptSamplingPriorityFromContext
methods.description: Extracts the sampling priority baggage item from a span context and applies it to a span builder.
